title: W3 Atomic cashier drawer transfers and shift variance Accounting Core journal
featureFlag: Finance ACTIVE AccountingPostingRule per event; default fail-closed without mapping
businessRules: CASH_IN and CASH_OUT in the POS are strictly ASSET-to-ASSET transfers with Finance-configured opposite account, not expense or revenue from cashier-controlled reason.
A manual cash transfer and POSTED balanced journal must commit atomically with existing receipt, audit and tenant-bound serializable transaction.
A short/over variance must post through Accounting Core before CLOSED state commits; fiscal period and close controls remain mandatory.
Previously unjournalled historical cash receipts cannot silently replay as if they were posted; no invented backfill.
Effective tax-period rules remain controlled by Tax Core; this W3 movement does not invent non-transfer expense taxation.
Cashier never sends account codes; only Finance can activate valid two-line debit/credit posting rules.
acceptanceCriteria: Every new till transfer has POSTED balanced journal from Accounting Core with CashierCashMovement source id; any missing mapping or close period fails before commit.
Both shift shortage and overage receive POSTED journal with typed Finance counter-account and source shift id; zero variance has no adjustment event.
Idempotent replay preserves original receipt and rejects legacy record lacking matching POSTED journal; no cross-branch leakage.
POS retains existing four P5 views, cash movement buttons and supervisor controls while warning transfer-only semantics.
Complete local gates, PostgreSQL fault injection, built browser UAT, exact-commit GitHub UAT and separate Human Stage-20 remain mandatory.

Simulated POS ESC/POS/RawBT/cash drawer/barcode and signed Digiflazz provider cases run as mandatory hard-failing gates in both exact-source GitHub heavy workflows; human/provider certification remain separate.

Exact-source GitHub PostgreSQL cashier runtime probe posts balanced real debit/credit lines for CASH_IN, CASH_OUT, SHORT, OVER; rejects overdraft, payload replay mismatch and duplicate close; aggregate/R8 cannot pass without its evidence.

Exact-source PostgreSQL W3 probe must reject CASHIER ledger/account rule mutations, missing Finance rule cash capture and variance close, and >5% cash withdrawal without supervisor approval, asserting zero affected database rows.
Fail-closed npm production audit and security proposal integrity: truncated audit JSON, inconsistent vulnerability counts, hidden HIGH findings or registry errors must never create a PASS.

The security-only lock resolver and candidate verifier reject partial Sharp native package graphs on every platform, including absent or wrongly classified optional @img/sharp binaries, before a lock can be adopted; full npm ci and HIGH/CRITICAL audit remain mandatory.

GitHub lock-recovery must exercise real sharp 0.35.5 native PNG generation and source-map-js 1.2.2 mapping after npm ci, and before unchanged production audit/UAT, failing closed if native binaries are unavailable.
testPlan: Check journal debit/credit balanced, tenant-scoped account rules and closed-period refusal on real PostgreSQL TEST.
Exercise idempotent retry, failure injection rollback, concurrent shift closure, cross-branch denial and supervisor grant.

migrationPlan: No database column/table/enum added. Existing AccountingEvent sourceType/sourceId, AccountingPosting, JournalEntry, accountingPostingRule and account relations are reused; historical rows are not backfilled.
rollbackPlan: Finance disables invalid posting rules to block NEW movements; preserve all committed AccountingEvent and journal rows, reconcile historical unjournalled movements explicitly, and perform any correction with Accounting Core compensating event only. Do not erase business evidence or schema.
monitoringPlan: Track missing or inactive finance rules, account type/branch mismatch, failed/posting-closed events, cash drawer shortage/overage, orphan historical movements and idempotency replay refusals; investigate physical-cash mismatch with Finance.
securityNotes: Cashier cannot choose GL accounts. Active rule and account types are resolved inside company/branch-scoped serializable transaction; existing supervisor one-time grant and drawer overdraft control remain enforced.
